phases.name: web_first_intake
phases.notes: Checked official React and Next performance references for measured rendering, memoization, transition behavior, and lazy loading.

phases.name: source_inspection_and_baseline
phases.notes: Inspected MonitorShell tab rendering path and measured CPU throttle 6 baseline tab switch timings.

phases.name: implementation
phases.notes: Added conditional rendering for Agents and Desktop Runtime section disclosures and removed useTransition from direct tab activation.

phases.name: verification
phases.notes: Ran check/test/build/customer/perf/platform checks plus latency, disclosure, and in-app Browser smoke audits.

phases.name: documentation_trace
phases.notes: Recorded REQ-WM-039, spec artifacts, web search, request trace, evaluation, omission, resource, and work summary records.

bottleneck_notes: The main measured bottleneck was closed disclosure children still being mounted during tab switches.
useTransition made the click-to-visible metric slightly worse for this specific direct navigation interaction, so it was removed.
